pageDescription: Institutional legal compliance information according to Laws No. 5,189/2014 and No. 5,282/2014 of the National University of Concepción.
heading: Institutional Transparency
description: In compliance with the Transparency Laws of the Republic of Paraguay, the National University of Concepción makes the following institutional information available to citizens.

ley5189.heading: Law No. 5,189/2014
ley5189.description: Establishing the mandatory provision of information by State bodies, entities and institutions.

ley5282.heading: Law No. 5,282/2014
ley5282.description: Free citizens' access to public and governmental information.
